newestFirst: Newest first. Saved to your learner record like any visit.
nothingYet: Nothing sent yet. Watch the video, open the collapse or answer the question.
undeclaredText: This block isn't in the xAPI vocabulary and hasn't declared that it sends nothing, so no one has decided whether it should track. Using it sends no statement.
undeclaredFix: Fix: add static get xapiVocabulary() to the element, or declare { tracks: false } if it should stay silent.
readingText: Scrolling through the page's content counts as one item, the same as each block that counts. It is read at 90% scrolled, not the last pixel.
checkpointText: It is a reading checkpoint: Reading this page notes when it stayed on screen, without a statement of its own.
checkpointSeen: Seen on this visit or before.
checkpointLine: Reading checkpoints seen: {seen} of {total}. The page is read once 80% of them were on screen for a moment.
